QF.id: VI Debt Instruments and Government Securities_31

question.text: Should the DP punch holes on the face of G-Sec certificates submitted for dematerialisation?

answer.text: No, the DP is instructed not to punch holes on the face of G-Secs
Yes, holes must be punched like other securities
Yes, but only after RBI confirmation
Only for certificates older than 10 years

explanation.text: The Logic: The DP is specifically instructed NOT to punch holes on the face of G-Secs, unlike the procedure for other securities sent to the issuer or R&T agent. The Trap: For regular certificates, punching holes is the standard defacement step, but G-Secs have a different handling procedure. Note: Follow the workbook rule: do not punch holes on the face of G-Secs.
